meta.title: DSH Git
meta.description: One clean git and GitHub surface: a single `git` tool for status, per-task worktrees, commit, push, sync, pull requests and merges, plus two automatic behaviours that remove the failure modes this profile kept hitting. At the end of every turn that changed files, their changes are committed and, when the branch is safe to push, pushed - so no work is left dirty or unsynced because a session forgot. A guard watches `bash` and redirects raw mutating git at the tool that does it consistently, denying the commands that discard work other sessions hold in a worktree. Worktrees live under ~/.dsh/worktrees/<repo>/<slug> on a dsh/<slug> branch, locked while a session owns them and only ever removed after their commits are pushed. How to use: ask the agent for the `git` tool, or type /git in the composer to print the working tree state. Auto-commit, auto-push, guard strictness, worktree location, branch prefix, protected branches and timeouts are all set by overriding this bundle's row in the profile's own patch layer.
